checks: Validate closed plan fields and exact seal; integers must reject bool substitutes.
Verify every source, bank, expected-binding, saved reconstruction, checkpoint and owner binding against external SHA256 and exact bytes.
Validate64 unique source/input IDs,32 train/32 development rows,8 disjoint declared groups per split, exact source and context hashes and all zero semantic masks.
Require source-only original policy, empty none_required contexts, no formal targets and no actor/action/object organizer channel.
Require observed native768 bundle with exact pinned Alibaba model and code profile;768 finite float32-compatible coordinates for every row.
Require PCA and mean derive only from the preceding TRAIN32 run, and saved AE endpoints derive from the selected200 checkpoint matching decoder seed.
Require all three selected400 decoder checkpoints match exact native768 context profile and current bound checkpoint owner pins; do not substitute trained384 or last800 states.
Validate all six views and18 arms, explicit selected-state/seed pairing, no DEV selection and no extra L2 operation.
Validate split-local rotation donor IDs and transformed vector hashes for all64 rows before source filtering.
Set CPU float32, one thread and bounded child process resources before numerical work; prevent optimizer steps and record actual call counters.
Every arm presents exactly the same64 exact source/context requests in the same order; only its declared vector recipe or conditioning-enabled flag changes.
Source preflight results are identical across all arms and seeds; preflight uses no representation, target, candidate or organizer facet.
Only eligible rows reach the decoder, while every blocked/unavailable/abstained row remains in the full output denominator.
Disabled and zero controls have different owner gate semantics; manual split-local rotation invokes owner control none to avoid a second rotation.
Decoder receipts bind the exact effective vectors, checkpoint, source text and state digest and expose no acceptance, fidelity or proof authority.
Every output proposal passes existing structural and source-span transport checks; malformed receipts are an experiment failure, not success.
Actual numerical model state, serialized checkpoint bytes and global Torch CPU RNG remain unchanged; optimizer count stays zero.
Reverify all selected bindings after execution; compare plan and source/cohort policy bytes with their pre-run bindings.
Validate18 primary arm outputs each contain64 ordered outcomes,1152 primary outcomes in total, split counts32/32 and complete outcome accounting.
Recompute all-request/split status counts and pairwise output/status parity from saved receipts without model replay or semantic targets.
Persist zero eligible/zero forward outcomes accurately if all requests are blocked; do not omit such arms or replace them with unconstrained decoder calls.
Report deterministic source representation controls once and seeded decoder arms individually; do not treat repeated control inputs as independent samples.
Use all registered seeds and selected states, retaining any failures with bounded exception categories and no credential-bearing text.
Record actual numerical restores/forwards and resource observations separately from any requested counts or validation-only method invocations.
Require all authority fields and semantic-admission masks stay false/zero; report structural/sensitivity results separately from unmeasured semantic outcomes.

focused_fixture_cases: A valid64-row plan validates without numerical calls.
One changed source/profile/target-policy binding rejects before model import.
A boolean mask or count rejects when the contract requires exact integer0 or row counts.
An extra reference/candidate/organizer field in an inference request rejects.
Cross-split or post-filter rotation rejects; split-local cyclic donation succeeds.
A reconstruction paired with the wrong seed/checkpoint rejects.
A retained384 learned legal-IR context profile rejects as incompatible native GTE384, despite matching dimension.
Empty eligible positions produce complete64 blocked outcomes and zero forwards.
An unavailable decoder outcome remains in all-request counts.
Disabled and zero remain distinct even when their generated outputs happen to match.
A requested18-arm summary with17 actual arm files rejects completeness claims.
Structural proposal validity never turns semantic or proof authority fields on.
